_help: Editable watch list for creator_stats.py. Add a handle to the right platform list and save; the next run picks it up. JSON has no comments, so keep the structure (commas, quotes, brackets) intact. Handles go WITHOUT the leading @.
_x_help: X/Twitter accounts. 'role' is a note for you, not used by the code: 'creator' = someone whose content style you benchmark against, 'feed' = a paper-discovery account whose engagement signals which papers are hot.
_instagram_help: Not wired up yet. Add Reels creators here when ready; needs a separate Apify actor.
_apify_help: Which Apify actor scrapes X, and how its input is shaped. Actor availability and pricing change, so this lives in config rather than in the code. 'lookback_days' bounds how far back each run reaches; 'max_items_per_run' is a hard cost ceiling — the run stops there no matter what.
_settings_help: console_top_n is how many rows the run prints as a leaderboard at the end.
